business_summary: Sichuan Swellfun Co.,Ltd engages in the production and sale of liquor and wine in China and internationally. The company offers products, such as First Distillery, Shui Jing Fang Dynasty Collections, Shui Jing Fang Forest Green, Shui Jing Fang Classics, Shui Jing Fang Wellbay, Shui Jing Fang No. 8, Shui Jing Fang Wellbay Collection, Shui Jing Fang Red Fortune, Four Gentlemen, Xiao Shui Jing, THC, and Shui Jing Fu. It is also involved in manufacturing of beverages and refined tea. Sichuan Swellfun Co.,Ltd was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Chengdu, China.

Sichuan Swellfun Co.,Ltd는 1993년에 설립되었으며 중국 청두에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
